web-guide-idea-60.audience: Families wanting to preserve a consenting relative’s memories.
web-guide-idea-60.offer: Guide a warm interview that helps someone tell their story. Agree separately whether it will be recorded, who receives it and how it will be stored.
web-guide-idea-60.steps.0: Prepare a few prompts and obtain everyone’s agreement.
web-guide-idea-60.steps.1: Ask open questions about a period, place or person.
web-guide-idea-60.steps.2: Recap names and dates, then agree any follow-up topics.
web-guide-idea-60.equipment: A phone and quiet space; recording is optional and must be agreed. Family photos can prompt memories.
web-guide-idea-60.returnReason: Create a series around childhood, work or family traditions, with the storyteller choosing the pace.
web-guide-idea-60.promotion: Share example prompts rather than a client’s private memories.
